impact_scope.description: The existing getaddrinfo numeric-service parsing path now requires a complete base-10 string in the range 0–65535; the new static helper is reached automatically by the existing caller.

evidence: In S0, ares_getaddrinfo_int already accepts the caller-supplied service string and parses numeric services.
H0 exercises DNS record parsing, query creation, and server-CSV parsing, but does not invoke the getaddrinfo service-parsing path.
In S1, the identical service-input path remains reachable through ares_getaddrinfo_int, which automatically passes the service string to numeric_service_to_port.
H0 remains unchanged and still does not invoke the getaddrinfo service-parsing path; it has no separate obligation to call the new static helper.

new_harness_obligation.description: The commit changes validation inside an already-existing omitted API path. Exercising it still requires the same action as in S0: call the getaddrinfo path with a fuzz-controlled service string.
evidence: numeric_service_to_port is static and is called internally by ares_getaddrinfo_int.
No new caller-supplied argument, buffer, configuration, call ordering, or special construction is introduced.

reason: The same caller-visible getaddrinfo service-parsing exposure is absent from H0 before and after. Stricter parsing and extraction into a private helper add behavior but no new harness action or reduced reachability, so the pre-existing gap is unchanged.
